problems.title: Least positive root after angle reduction
problems.question: Find the least positive solution of sin(π/2−x)=cos(3π/2−x).
problems.idea: Reduce the question using the rule below, then check the allowed values.
formulas: The two sides simplify to cosx and−sinx.
steps: Thus cosx+sinx=0, so x=−π/4+πk.
The least positive value uses k=1.

problems.title: Full surface of a square frustum
problems.question: A regular square frustum has base diagonals6√6 and8√6, and lower-base dihedral30°. Find total surface area.
problems.idea: Reduce the question using the rule below, then check the allowed values.
steps: The apothem is√3/(√3/2)=2.
Lateral area=half the sum of base perimeters times apothem=28√3·2=56√3.
Base areas total108+192=300.

problems.title: A binomial term with equal variable exponents
problems.question: In $((a^2/b^3)^{1/5}+(b^3/a^2)^{1/7})^n$, a term $T_k$ contains equal powers of a and b. Find k/n.
problems.idea: Reduce the question using the rule below, then check the allowed values.
steps: Exponent of a is2(n−k)/5−2k/7; exponent of b is−3(n−k)/5+3k/7.
Equating them gives(n−k)/5=k/7, hence7n=12k.
problems.note: If Tₖ is counted from1 instead, the equality gives(k−1)/n=7/12. The indexing convention matters.

problems.title: A visa type conditional on exactly one approval
problems.question: Visa probabilities for USA,Canada,Mexico are.3,.5,.9. Given exactly one visa, find the probability it is USA.
problems.idea: Reduce the question using the rule below, then check the allowed values.
steps: The exactly-one probability is.015+.7·.5·.1+.7·.5·.9=.365.
problems.note: The stated marginal probabilities do not determine this conditional probability without a joint model such as independence.

problems.title: Inclination of a right triangle’s plane
problems.question: A right triangle’s hypotenuse lies in plane M. Its legs make30° and60° with M. Find the sine of the angle between its plane and M.
problems.idea: Reduce the question using the rule below, then check the allowed values.
formulas: Let the right-angle vertex’s height above M be H. Leg lengths are a=2H,b=2H/√3.
steps: Hypotenuse=√(a²+b²)=4H/√3. The triangle altitude to it is ab/c=H.
In a perpendicular section, H=(triangle altitude)sinδ, so sinδ=1.

problems.title: A reciprocal fourth-power expression
problems.question: Given sinα+cosα=m, find1/sin⁴(π/2+α)+1/cos⁴(3π/2−α).
problems.idea: Reduce the question using the rule below, then check the allowed values.
formulas: The denominators are cos⁴α and sin⁴α. Put p=sinαcosα=(m²−1)/2.
steps: The sum is(sin⁴α+cos⁴α)/(sin⁴αcos⁴α)=(1−2p²)/p⁴.
Substituting p gives[16−8(m²−1)²]/(m²−1)⁴.
problems.answer: [16−8(m²−1)²]/(m²−1)⁴, for the original defined angles, so m²≠1.

problems.title: Surface area of a pyramid over a parallelogram
problems.question: Base sides10,12 enclose30°. A lateral edge of length12 is perpendicular to the base. Find total surface area.
problems.idea: Reduce the question using the rule below, then check the allowed values.
steps: The two faces meeting the perpendicular edge have areas10·12/2=60 and12·12/2=72.
For the opposite side of length10, the projected distance is12sin30°=6; slant altitude=√(12²+6²)=6√5, area30√5.
For the opposite side12, projected distance=10sin30°=5; slant altitude13, area78. Add all five areas.

problems.title: Exactly199 solutions of a cosine-root equation
problems.question: Find all a giving exactly199 distinct x with cos√(a−x²)=1.
problems.idea: Reduce the question using the rule below, then check the allowed values.
formulas: The root must equal2πk for integer k≥0; thus x²=a−4π²k².
steps: Each positive right side contributes two roots; a zero contributes one. An odd total therefore requires a=4π²m² for integer m≥0.
For that a, k=0,…,m−1 contribute2m roots, and k=m contributes zero once.

problems.title: A perpendicular section of a regular triangular pyramid
problems.question: A regular triangular pyramid has base side4√3 and lateral edge6. Find the section through midpoints of two adjacent base sides perpendicular to the opposite lateral face.
problems.idea: Reduce the question using the rule below, then check the allowed values.
formulas: Base altitude=6, base circumradius4, pyramid height=√(36−16)=2√5.
steps: Put the opposite base edge BC at y=0,vertex A at y=6 and apex S at y=2,z=2√5. The midpoint segment is y=3,z=0.
The opposite face has slope√5 in this perpendicular view; the section has slope−1/√5, so z=(3−y)/√5.
It meets SB,SC at one quarter of their length from B,C. The section’s parallel sides are2√3 and3√3.
